classification.difficultyReason: Plan a linked argument by transferring angles between parallels and identifying the remaining region of a straight angle or revolution; part c requires introducing or exploiting a parallel through the target vertex.

content.prompt: Find the size of the marked angle $\angle POQ$ in each diagram below. Each solution will require two or more steps, each with its own reason.

spec.description: Straight horizontal PONM, with OQ parallel to NR; NQ joins the two rays. All original labels and both numerical givens are retained.
spec.mathematics: OQ parallel NR; angle QNR = 55 degrees; angle MNR = 45 degrees; marked angle POQ.
spec.answerVisibility: Givens only; the marked angle is unlabelled.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\angle NOQ&=45^\circ\end{align*}$$
Corresponding angles, $NR\parallel OQ$.
$$\begin{align*}\angle POQ&=180^\circ-45^\circ\\\angle POQ&=135^\circ\end{align*}$$
Straight angle at $O$.

spec.description: Triangle POQ with PQ extended, straight OQR and FQG, and matching parallel arrows on PO and FG.
spec.mathematics: PO parallel FG; the rightward horizontal ray splits angle GQR into 25 degrees and 18 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Givens only; angle POQ is marked without a value.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\angle FQR&=180^\circ-25^\circ-18^\circ\\\angle FQR&=137^\circ\end{align*}$$
Straight angle at $Q$.
$$\begin{align*}\angle POQ&=137^\circ\end{align*}$$
Corresponding angles, $PO\parallel FG$.

spec.description: Two adjoining quadrilateral outlines share ON. Distinct single, double and triple parallel-arrow families are preserved. ON has no parallel marking.
spec.mathematics: PA parallel QB; PO parallel AN; OQ parallel NB; angle APO = 45 degrees; angle OQB = 35 degrees; marked upper angle POQ.
spec.answerVisibility: Givens only; no auxiliary construction or answer appears.

answer.short:
$80^\circ$

Use a parallel ray through $O$, then angles in a revolution.
answer.worked:
Construct a downward ray $OT$ through $O$ parallel to $PA$ and $QB$.
$$\begin{align*}\angle POT&=180^\circ-45^\circ\\\angle POT&=135^\circ\end{align*}$$
Co-interior angles, $PA\parallel OT$.
$$\begin{align*}\angle QOT&=180^\circ-35^\circ\\\angle QOT&=145^\circ\end{align*}$$
Co-interior angles, $QB\parallel OT$.
$$\begin{align*}\angle POQ&=360^\circ-135^\circ-145^\circ\\\angle POQ&=80^\circ\end{align*}$$
Revolution at $O$.

spec.description: Three horizontal parallel intervals XP, OY and ZQ, joined by PO and QO; the angle on the left of O is marked.
spec.mathematics: XP parallel OY parallel ZQ; angle XPO = 160 degrees; angle ZQO = 150 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Numerical givens only; marked angle POQ remains unknown.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\angle POY&=160^\circ\end{align*}$$
Alternate angles, $XP\parallel OY$.
$$\begin{align*}\angle QOY&=150^\circ\end{align*}$$
Alternate angles, $ZQ\parallel OY$.
$$\begin{align*}\angle POQ&=360^\circ-160^\circ-150^\circ\\\angle POQ&=50^\circ\end{align*}$$
Revolution at $O$.
